description: List the library-level domain referrers (Domain Protection / allow-block list for playback). Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status }] } where type is ALLOW|BLOCK and status is one of active|inactive|pending|deleting|turning_inactive. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_list_refer
title: List Domain Referrers (library)
